_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.373 adds a single-file MATLAB replay of the actual firmware estimator and corrects the native DAQ channel layout after a USB retry.

Download smart_pvr_firmware.m to replay the device numerical code. It contains the C++ source and compiles a cached MEX on the first call, requiring a supported MATLAB C++ compiler. The existing compiler-free smart_pvr_offline.m remains a separate research implementation. The MATLAB ZIP includes both entries, the updated quickstart and a three-page illustrated guide; the installed application's HTML Help links both.

Validation: 3,024 historical deflations and 85 synthetic/failure cases matched the separately compiled host firmware module with zero acceptance, rejection-reason or execution-path discrepancies. Maximum peak difference was below 0.000005 mmHg. Identical 50 Hz captures are required for this comparison. Desktop replay does not reproduce ARM elapsed time, the 9.5-second device deadline or live safety inputs. The historical data were used during development and do not constitute independent clinical validation or establish the best constant-hold offset.

The DAQ correction was reproduced for both three-to-two and two-to-three channel changes after a USB start retry. 64 focused DAQ checks and 116 release/profile/startup/preset checks passed; seven standard GUI scripts and 503 helper/parser/worker/analyzer assertions passed. The headless GUI smoke and layout checks passed. Every guide page was rendered and inspected. The older intermittent native GUI crash remains unexplained; this separate correction is not evidence of its cause.

Firmware remains rev27v-followup-348 (11/10/2026). No firmware, controller gains, calibration or pressure limits changed. Accepted PVR target = peak+5, capped at 130 mmHg for Smart Const or 140 for High Max; rejected analyses return 80. Larger-cuff, physical-control/fault and real second-PC fleet tests still require the named setup and measurement evidence.

Default source: cb303677806a4233d8e012089d1ac21ae4a8a9ce. Installer: 224447407 bytes, SHA-256 7ae1559ab8af2e834f9e15f73446489f9f8d00264b4e4b5a063523b77b517e62. The clean build receipt is attached. Authenticode is unsigned as previously authorized; on a first installation, use More info -> Run anyway if Windows SmartScreen asks.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
